instruction: A blocky voxel toadstool built from cubic pixels, with a domed scarlet cap studded by white cube-warts and a stubby ivory stalk on a mossy green voxel base. Stepped edges and a limited palette give it a crisp retro-videogame appearance.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Amanita Toadstool in a voxel/pixel style. A blocky voxel toadstool built from cubic pixels, with a domed scarlet cap studded by white cube-warts and a stubby ivory stalk on a mossy green voxel base. Stepped edges and a limited palette give it a crisp retro-videogame appearance. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
